news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there is only 1 independent director on the board. The company's board is composed of: 1 independent director. 3 non-independent directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Nikesh Oswal was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2017. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Foundry Fuel Products Limited Announces Resignation of Mrs. Sudha Ramesh as Non-Executive Independent Woman Director, Effective 12 February, 2026
news.body: Foundry Fuel Products Limited at its Board of directors meeting held on February 12, 2026 approved the resignation of Mrs. Sudha Ramesh (DIN: 02840031) from the position of Non-Executive Independent Woman Director of the Company due to her personal reasons and unavoidable circumstances, effective February 12, 2026.
